title: File transfer over FTP keeps timing out
description: I'm connecting to the FTP server for backups, the listing comes through but the transfer hangs once it starts.

worklogs.description: Found that the 49152-65535 outbound port range for passive FTP was closed.
Added a PASV-RANGE rule on the firewall, transfer test successful.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The passive FTP port range has been opened. Could you try again and let me know?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: I tested it, a 500MB file transferred without any issues. Thanks.

resolutionNote: Added a 49152-65535 outbound allow rule for passive FTP to the firewall. Transfer successful.
